description: Stability first: the stable preset opens one grouped PR on the 1st of the month with releases at least 14 days old; majors wait for a tick on the Dependency Dashboard; nothing merges itself.

customManagers.description: The global mise config is a chezmoi template, not valid TOML, so the mise manager can't parse it. Its exact pins carry a renovate annotation on the line above; the 'latest' entries move with `mise up` on each machine instead.

packageRules.description: gitleaks runs twice in the gate, from mise.toml (make audit) and as a pre-commit hook; keep them on one version.
